title: Population & Demography Data
description: Global human population distribution for 2020 derived from the Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL R2023A), published by the European Commission JRC. Available as a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF at ~90 m resolution (3 arc-seconds, WGS84) and as area-weighted H3 hexagonal grid aggregations at resolution 9, with a validated global total of 7.84 billion people. Intended as a growing collection of population and demography surfaces, with WorldPop and LandScan layers planned.

readme:
## README.md
# public-population

Global and regional human **population & demography** layers on NRP S3.
Seeded with GHS-POP (GHSL R2023A); future home for WorldPop, LandScan, and age-stratified surfaces.

## ghs-pop-2020 — GHS-POP 2020 Global Population (R2023A, 3 arc-second / ~90 m)

Source: European Commission JRC, GHSL R2023A. License: CC-BY-4.0. Projection: WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

**Assets**
- COG: `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-population/raw/ghs-pop-2020-cog.tif`
- H3 hex (res 9, area-weighted SUM): `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-population/ghs-pop-2020/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet`

The hex layer is **area-weighted to H3 resolution 9 via exact_extract** — one row per h9 cell,
population already summed into the cell. `SUM(population)` is directly valid (no GROUP BY / dedup).
Validated against the COG pixel-sum: **7.84 billion** (2020 world population).

### DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- global total population
SELECT SUM(population) AS people
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-population/ghs-pop-2020/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet',
                  hive_partitioning => true);
-- → ~7.84e9

-- roll up to a coarser resolution (parents are precomputed)
SELECT h6, SUM(population) AS people
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-population/ghs-pop-2020/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet',
                  hive_partitioning => true)
GROUP BY h6;
```

Raster-derived dataset: COG + H3 hex only (no PMTiles). Visualize the COG via titiler.
